scope: Decode baseline arms of the 12 accepted D092 full metadata dumps. Check all row intervals, actual action/chance consumers and old writer ordering. CPU source/integer model only: no new plan build, compiler, CUDA context, kernel, solver, timing or source activation.
fixed_checks: All actual CFV row IDs are in range, root is zero, every row is written during each full up sweep.

Every action/chance read sees its exact child as last writer under unchanged per-level fold/show/chance/action schedule. Same-level outputs cannot alias any input or other output; persistent terminal rows are disjoint.
BR full producer pass followed by average pass with retained terminals has identical row-writer identities; a full pass does not need incoming CFV bytes from a prior player.

For every row and each p, [row*nh[p],(row+1)*nh[p]) is injective, same-row/same-hand aliases exactly match old spacing, original allocation cfv_blocks*nh_max bounds all accesses; hand permutations stay in nh[p].
Root extraction/evaluation-root offsets remain at original zero/fixed nh_max spacing; no allocation/admission/payload or saved layout changes.
proposal: Only two existing local assignments in paired_sweep and eval_up pass nh_p instead of self.nh_max as CFV stride. Every original kernel/float expression/count/schedule/slot map/learning and reach allocation/save remains. Shader code/compiled resources identical; changing row spacing still requires real GPU raw semantic/guard/state/graph tests and full performance/material qualification.
admission: Require all 12 exact finite models, positive hand counts and at least one canonical asymmetric layout. This only admits one off-tree host prototype; no speed/capacity/no-tradeoff claim follows from narrower address envelopes. Keep 1%/strictfixture/fresh16/broad/material/holdout/fresh-original gates unchanged.
failure_policy: Close exact per-traverser unpadded CFV stride form on real structural/numerical/performance/material failure; no padding/factor/subset/helper/source-scope/placement variant or extra samples rescue. Reader-only bookkeeping may replay retained observations.
